exposure: elective cervical cerclage removal at term
outcome: time interval between cerclage removal and spontaneous onset of labour
cohort: The study included women who had cervical cerclage inserted for suspected cervical insufficiency at two tertiary health institutions in Enugu state, Nigeria, over a ten-year period.
finding: The mean time interval from elective cervical cerclage removal at term to spontaneous onset of labour was 12 days, with the majority of patients (45.6%) experiencing labour in the second week after removal.
